_comment: Temporary npm audit exceptions. Each entry needs id (GHSA or CVE), reason, issue (GitHub issue URL), exposure (runtime|build), and review_by (YYYY-MM-DD). Expired, unused, or build-classified runtime findings fail the security gate. Prefer a targeted lockfile/override fix over an exception.

exceptions.reason: braces <=3.0.3 stack-exhaustion DoS; no patched release exists yet. Reached only via the dev-only shadcn CLI (fast-glob -> micromatch -> braces); not in npm audit --omit=dev nor in frontend/dist.
